facts.author: Nik Koios
facts.headline: The Strategic Silence: Democrats Mute Climate as Systems Fracture
facts.summary: Democratic politicians are scrubbing climate language from campaigns after electoral losses, treating the crisis as a political liability. This silence ignores how climate tipping points are already fracturing economic stability and community safety across the nation. Treating the overheating planet as a third rail ensures voters remain unprepared for the scale of coming disruption.
